facts.fact: The South African Weather Service peer review says the Seychelles Meteorological Authority's forecasting section has access to EUMETSAT satellite products through the internet and that access to satellite data assists its nowcasting services.

The South African Weather Service peer review says the Seychelles Meteorological Authority has implemented a QMS with ISO 9001/2015 certification for international air navigation in full, also covering climate services.

facts.fact: The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Seychelles among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.

The Minister said at the 20 March 2026 event that observations from weather stations, satellites and ocean monitoring form the foundation of the Seychelles Meteorological Authority's forecasts and warnings.
